source.author: cic
source.text: tum etiam illi quinque qui imperitorum hominum rumusculos aucupati tum illum absolverunt iam suam clementiam laudari magno opere nolebant; a quibus si qui quaereret sedissentne iudices in C. Fabricium, sedisse se dicerent; si interrogarentur num quo crimine is esset accusatus praeterquam veneni eius quod quaesitum habito diceretur, negarent; si deinde essent rogati quid iudicassent, condemnasse se dicerent; nemo enim absolvit.
source.text_original: tum etiam illi quinque qui imperitorum hominum rumusculos aucupati tum illum absolverunt iam suam clementiam laudari magno opere nolebant; a quibus si qui quaereret sedissentne iudices in C. Fabricium, sedisse se dicerent; si interrogarentur num quo crimine is esset accusatus praeterquam veneni eius quod quaesitum habito diceretur, negarent; si deinde essent rogati quid iudicassent, condemnasse se dicerent; nemo enim absolvit.
source.text_english: Then those five men as well, having caught at the whispers of uninformed people and having acquitted that man, were now greatly unwilling for their clemency to be praised; and if anyone should ask them whether the judges had sat in the case of C. Fabricius, they would say that they had sat; if they were asked whether he had been accused on any charge besides that of the poison concerning which an inquiry was said to have been held, they would deny it; if then they were asked what verdict they had given, they would say that they had condemned him; for no one acquits.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Caue, ne hominum rumusculos aucuperis, ne offensam dei populorum laude commutes.
reuse.text_original: Caue, ne hominum rumusculos aucuperis, ne offensam dei populorum laude commutes.
reuse.text_english: Take care lest you hunt after little rumors of men, lest you exchange offense against God for the praise of the people.
